name: Masumaro — "twice the number of" doubles a counted CDA
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (theme: remaining P/T CDAs). 'equal to twice the number of cards in your hand' did not match the count CDA regex at all. The regex now accepts 'twice' and stamps cdaMultiplier: 2, applied in engine-apply after the count (and after any typed-in override). Hand size 3 gives Masumaro 6/6. Mwonvuli Ooze ('1 plus twice the number of age counters on it') with two age counters is 5/5. Territorial Maro (twice the basic land types among lands you control; Forest + Island) is 4/4, which also covers the new domain count.
